what: The Hills cloud, the inner Oort cloud, as dots along orbits following Nesvorny et al. (2025), Fig. 3 (arXiv:2502.11252): a disk tilted to the ecliptic, with two arms, filling in across the range where its inner edge is thought to lie.
frame: ecliptic and equinox of J2000, centred on the Sun, the orrery's drawing frame
rounding: each coordinate to the nearest whole AU: a drawing, not a measurement, and half an AU is invisible at this scale
